heading: About me
about.lead: I’m studying Software Engineering at Addis Ababa University.
paragraphs: I’m working toward my bachelor’s degree, expected in 2030. My interests include full-stack development, machine learning, and computer vision.
At Addis Tech Group, I work on responsive web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

experience.description: Building and improving responsive web applications with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, with a focus on performance and maintainability.
Developing a foundation in software engineering while exploring practical applications in web development, machine learning, and computer vision.
